notes.title: Winter Update
notes.content:
Happy Holidays!🎄
This Winter Update adds a splash of festive joy to Bird Simulator 24 with the following:

New Skin:

 Dress your crow in a cozy Holiday Sweater to celebrate the season in style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231007/0c0da48a1ae037f2901020d0df63d429865ed6fa.png
Changes:

 Enchanced object grabbing system
 You can no longer poop on yourself
 Changed location of one of the secret hats


Don’t forget to grab the game during the Winter Sale and experience the chaos like never before! 
Now with a 30% off discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3262870/Bird_Simulator_24/
Thank you for your ongoing support, and stay tuned for more updates.

Enjoy the festivities and happy gaming! 🐦✨

notes.title: It's here! Bird Simulator 24 is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
Bird Simulator 24 has officially launched on Steam! 🐦💥

Step into the feathers of a mischievous crow and dive into a chaotic world full of unique powers and tasty treats. Bird Simulator 24 lets you create your own brand of street mayhem. From pooping on pedestrians to collecting quirky hats, there’s no end to the fun!

Features:

 8 unique skins
 6 hillarious hats + 2 secret ones
 34 Steam achievements
 7 mighty power-ups
 6 golden bread loafs
 2 different stages with distinct gamemodes
 and 3 easter eggs...

Much more coming soon!

Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or push for a new high score, Bird Simulator 24 is here to bring the chaos.

 Let the crow chaos begin!
